# Valley

> Valley is an AI outbound platform. It finds your best buyers — warm LinkedIn signals, deep search, or your own lists — researches each one across 200+ sources, qualifies them against your ICP, and sends messages in your voice that get 15–45% replies.

Key facts about Valley:

- Valley is **the complete outbound system**: finding buyers and writing messages are two jobs, and Valley does both. Most rivals sell one half — prospecting tools that can't write, or sequencing tools that can't tell a buyer from a bystander.
- Valley finds buyers three ways: **warm signals** (profile viewers, post engagers, followers — these reply about 3x more often), **Valley Deep** (describe your ICP in plain language and Valley finds matching companies across the live web), and **your own lists** (CSV, Sales Navigator, API).
- Valley then **qualifies against your ICP and discards the rest** — you only message the top slice.
- Messages are researched first, always: **200+ sources per prospect**. Writing style is trained on a corpus of **500K+ real messages** and learns from your edits.
- **You stay in control.** Approve every message, or let them flow. Valley is not an autonomous agent you hand the keys to.
- Typical reply rates: **15–45%**. Category average is roughly **2%**.
- **30M+ messages sent. Zero LinkedIn restrictions across 1,000+ accounts and 300+ teams.**
- Runs mostly on LinkedIn because that is where B2B buyers answer. **Email is included on every plan** — your own Gmail or Microsoft inbox via OAuth, 1 per seat. Email-only campaigns are capped at 30 emails/day/seat. Valley does not provide managed mailboxes or inbox warmup and is not a volume-email platform.
- Replaces the stack teams duct-tape together — Sales Navigator, Clay, ChatGPT, HeyReach, Zapier — with one system.
- Customers include **Miro, UiPath, Bolt.new, ThinkFish, GGWP, and Brex**.
- Pricing starts at **$149/month billed quarterly**, or **$199/month** month-to-month, with a **7-day free trial** (card required). Everything is unlocked on day one — you are choosing depth and support, not unlocking features. *(Pricing changed July 2026 — previously from $395/month.)*
